safeguard_sidecar.resume_policy: Require a matching sidecar for non-default safeguards; validate checkpoint and reference hashes; never recapture a missing active anchor during resume.
safeguard_sidecar.default_policy: The historical defaults need no sidecar, so legacy default checkpoints remain readable.

changes.anchor_kernel: Parameter-space restoring gradient; PPOTrainer skips dispatch when lambda is zero. This is not a KL trust-region guarantee.

active_anchor_resume_probe.comparison: 2 continuous rollouts vs 1 rollout plus resume

verification.metal_training_lock: results/metal-training.lock held during build, test, and training/resume probes

compatibility_limits: Existing default checkpoints remain resumable without a safeguard sidecar.
Existing non-default checkpoints created before this sidecar cannot be resumed under non-default settings; use an explicit warmstart into a new run.
Changing any safeguarded update setting on resume is rejected.
verification.training_claim: No new long training was run. Prior MiMo evidence did not beat the existing 25/30 connected-rooms dev result. The anchor is supported as a retention mechanism from a strong checkpoint, not as a better peak or from-scratch generalization improvement.
